item.title: Self-Hosted Greylisting Servers: Postgrey vs Sqlgrey vs Rspamd Greylisting
item.description: Greylisting is one of the simplest yet most effective anti-spam techniques available to self-hosted mail administrators. By temporarily rejecting email from unknown senders and expecting legitimate mail servers to retry delivery, greylisting blocks the vast majority of spam at the SMTP level — before the message body is even accepted.
